title: Canon Foundation Research Fellowship
summary: Fellowships for European researchers to study in Japan and Japanese PhD researchers to study in Europe, supporting all fields of research.

degree_levels.notes: Applicants should have obtained at least a Master's or PhD degree. Target group mentions graduates, doctoral candidates/PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, faculty.

subject_areas.notes: The research grants support all fields of research. There are no limitations or restrictions.

institutions.notes: Canon Fellows from Europe are free to choose their host institutes and hosts in Japan.

nationality.notes: European and Japanese researchers. Specific countries listed in the dropdown: Albania, Andorra, Austria, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kosovo, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Moldova, Republic of, Monaco, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, San Marino, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, Vatican City.

residence.notes: Europeans should have permanent citizenship in the country. 'Country' is the country in which you are living and from which you are applying.

mandatory.text: Europeans should have permanent citizenship in the country.
Applicants should have obtained at least a Master's or PhD degree within the last 10 years of applying to the Canon Foundation.

preferences.text: Priority is given to applicants going to Europe and Japan for the first time.

exceptions.text: Exceptions are possible regarding the requirement to have obtained a Master's or PhD degree within the last 10 years.

funding.description: The financial support for Research Fellows may amount up to 30,000 EUR per year and pro-rata for different periods.
funding.duration: minimum period of 3 months up to maximum of 1 year

application_rounds.notes: Applicable deadlines will be published on the website.

steps.text: Access application forms and further information on the application procedure on the Canon Foundation website.
